general_information.Description: The unit is designed to provide participants with an appreciation of the major issues that arise in the management of a financial institution's assets and liabilities. The course is intended for those undergraduate students in the Finance and Banking major. It also helps the student obtain a thorough understanding of capital adequacy of banks, management of the capital structure, bank earnings, importance of attracting a deposit base, liquidity, investment portfolio composition, lending, audit, personnel, and the policies and procedures of each of these areas. In addition, the major focus in this unit is on understanding the management of the four main risks on a financial institution’s balance sheet: capital risk, liquidity risk, credit risk and interest rate risk. With interest rates now at historical lows and asset values, particularly shares, suffering major declines, financial institutions are now trying to protect their profitability by carefully managing these risks.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.lms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

assessments.Question Type: Students should attend all the sessions and actively participate in class discussion for full credit.
assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Class preparation and pre-reading before lecture will be assessed upon individuals' understanding and ability to answer questions in the class. Individuals will be called up randomly to be assessed.
